name: jobpilot
description: JobPilot Chrome MV3 extension. The side panel UI is React 19 built with Vite — run `npm run build` and load dist/ unpacked; loading the repo root will NOT work. Everything outside sidepanel/react (background worker, content script, and the sidepanel/js logic layer) is still dependency-free vanilla JS and is copied or bundled as-is.
